title: Groupe SERL
description: groupe-serl.fr Revenue $150 Million Groupe SERL is a French engineering and construction group founded in 1985 in Rennes, Brittany, specializing in civil and industrial construction, MEP systems, facility management and energy solutions across France. With approximately 800 to 1,000 employees and estimated revenue of 120 to 150 million euro, it operates regional offices in Nantes, Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille and Toulouse. Its services span gross construction, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire protection, lift installation and renewable energy including solar and heat pumps. The group also provides full facility management including preventive and corrective maintenance, technical building management and energy optimization. It serves office, industrial, healthcare, education, retail, hotel and logistics sectors. Its motto is Build, Maintain, Innovate, reflecting a full lifecycle approach from construction through long-term operations.
